title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1982-04-18
lineage: MAC > Nakamichi DR-2 > Edirol FA-66 > Wavelab 2448 > R8Brain > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1644 Tagged. Transfer by Andrew F. 01/2012
source: AUD: 2x Nakamichi CM300's > Sony TC-D5M > TDK MA-90's. Set up behind the stage, recorded from the rear-facing P.A. system. Taped by Joe Morrone.

ai_review.summary: Rich behind‑stage capture with deep drum ambience and a patient, inspiring second set that really shines.
ai_review.review: The recording offers an unusual behind‑stage sound—less crowd, more snares depth and added reverb—that gives the band a warm but slightly thin texture. Musically the show is praised for its patient, inspired playing, especially the second set and the memorable Earthquake Space jam. Overall it’s a kick‑ass performance despite the modest board quality.

ai_rating.rationale: Four detailed reviews with an average of 4.25 stars; strong praise for the show’s second set and decent, if not perfect, recording quality yields a solid combined rating.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Behind‑stage/audience capture gives extra snare depth and less crowd noise; sound is warm with reverb but not as up‑front, vocals feel thin/tinny and overall board quality is modest.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Second set highlighted for patience, inspiration and strong flow; overall show considered kick‑ass.

band_member_comments.Drums: Snares noted for extra depth and presence compared to typical audience mixes.
